definitions.explanation: A bat-and-ball sport played between two teams of nine players each, extremely popular in Japan.

examples.japanese: {野球|やきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：03091_koro⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{野球|やきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I played baseball every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧{野球|やきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{甲子園|こうしえん}→甲子園：23102_koushien⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風物詩|ふうぶつし}→風物詩：08649_fuubutsushi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The Koshien high school baseball tournament is a summer tradition.

notes:
{野球|やきゅう} is one of the most popular sports in Japan. Professional baseball (⟦{プロ野球|ぷろやきゅう}→プロ野球：08837_puroyakyuu⟧) has 12 teams divided into two leagues. High school baseball, particularly the ⟦{甲子園|こうしえん}→甲子園：23102_koushien⟧ tournament, enjoys immense popularity.

Common expressions:
- {野球|やきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to play baseball)
- {野球|やきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to watch baseball)
- ⟦{野球部|やきゅうぶ}→野球部：27441_yakyuubu⟧ (baseball club)
- ⟦{野球場|やきゅうじょう}→野球場：23770_yakyuujou⟧ (baseball stadium)
